chief_complaint: Nasal congestion, sore throat, cough and mild fever for 2 days
history_of_present_illness: Patient reports 2 days of nasal blockage, severe throat pain especially in the evening, cough, mild fever (up to 99‑100°F), difficulty swallowing and drinking water, hoarseness, symptoms aggravated by dust exposure and known dust allergy. examination_findings: Throat appears clear with slight redness.
advice: Symptomatic treatment with the above medicines; no antibiotics at this time. If fever becomes high or there is no improvement within 3 days, consider review for possible antibiotics.
